method: Geometry first, from prims.pkl of l30. Listed all top-level A-DOOR inserts (11 centred in the box) and every door-like block nested in the linked central model (D36, D37 x2, Door NO_03, NO_17, D_Swing_Single 700 / 900 PAN, D_Openning_Lift); dumped frames, leaves and arcs. Built the wall footprint (A-WALL, A-WALL-PATT, S-COLS hatches plus polygonised thin outlines), sliced it along every wall centre line to read the exact wall-end faces of each gap and the wall thickness (verify_ab.py: every a/b equals the slice gap to 1-2 mm), and ran my own ray test on all short wall ends to find every pair of wall ends facing each other (all explained, see rejected). Then checked pictures: 24 tiles of 5x5 m (grid 0.5, --inserts, 2000 px) t_x{-4.5,0.5,5.5,10.5}_y{-58,-53,-48,-43,-38,-33} covering x -4.5..15.5, y -58..-29.5, plus zooms (north block, west stair, SW and NW WC, shaft rooms, core, stair gap). Final render with --mark on all 34 openings and a door-layers-only render: no unmarked door symbol, arc, track or wall gap remains. Conventions: wall-end faces on the centre line, frames included; lift landings without leaf = passage + optional; 7 toilet cubicle doors (leaf drawn at 45 deg) = door + optional; doorless wall gaps with wall ends facing each other = passage; the curtain-wall facade is in glassWalls. Note: most doors here are nested inserts inside the linked central model (layer 0, arcs on A-DETL-GENF-HDLN), not top-level A-DOOR inserts. Door 3AC9 (centre x=15.605) is outside the box and not listed.
